title: Clear signup errors while correcting fields
steps: Inspect the signup form with email alex and revealed password short, each displaying a red validation message.
Click Email Address and append @example.com, leaving the corrected email focused.
Click Password to move focus away from Email Address.
Select the password text and type Kestrel!482, leaving Password focused; inspect the form.

video_guide.summary: Correct the email and password in turn and inspect the validation feedback beside each field.

chapters.note: Email Address contains alex with an invalid-email message; Password contains short with a minimum-eight-character message. Both fields have red borders.
Email Address contains alex@example.com with a green outline and no invalid-email message; Password is still short with a red border and length error.

chapters.label: Move to Password and replace short with Kestrel!482

chapters.note: Password contains Kestrel!482 with a green outline and no minimum-length message.
Both corrected values are visible, and neither field has an error message.
